scope: Two targeted browser cases for HTTP-directory model registration; no site/page percentage claim

recovery.name: 模型管理 / 预览后上游目录失效 / 注册拒绝且修复后成功

fixture: Unique loopback HTTP directory with actual config.json, exact HEAD lengths, auditable GET/HEAD and controllable HTTP503; fresh server/SQLite/context per case

MISSING: URL Enter-to-preview and form Enter-to-register paths, including exactly one mutation and explicit-button equivalence

partial.1.8: all HTTP registration fields; no other source modes
partial.1.15: Tab, focus border, named modal/footer viewport; other states missing

result: NOT_RUN until matching report has PASS, all required evidence, unchanged source hashes and artifact scan
artifacts: secrets/e2e/<runId>/report.json, redacted trace/screenshots/server log; raw DB/log private
cleanup: UI deletes only owned model; runner stops owned server/HTTP listener even on failure, retains isolated diagnosis DB at most seven days
